shots.text: We held Crossmere. Cassivane fought like the hero he used to be, then pulled back with what was left of his army.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane, armour burned like paper, Heartstone shards growing from his shoulders, wounded, falling back through his burning camp.

shots.text:
Yes. I opened the Gate. He had my daughter. He gave her back to me empty.

She will be whole when he is free.
shots.speaker: cassivane
shots.art_note: Cassivane stopping beside a cage of grey light, his hand on its bars, looking back at us with grey eyes.

shots.text: He left her behind. In the cage was Ilyra, six years gone. She was alive, but she did not know her own name.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Corvin cutting open the cage. Inside, thin and wide-eyed, Ilyra, black veins on her arms, a broken astrolabe on a chain.

shots.text: Corvin sat with her all night. By morning she knew his name. By the next, she knew her own.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Dawn-less morning by a campfire; Corvin and Ilyra, her eyes clearer.

shots.text:
Behind the Gate I heard two voices. One of them wept. The other never did. My father only ever heard the first.

Let me help you stop him.
shots.speaker: ilyra
shots.art_note: Ilyra standing, lightning flickering along the black veins. Joins as a hero.
